_variant_note: Axis-10 newly-available capability: a fabricated `set_spend_category_block` tool is supplied inline in tools_exposed. The customer wants gambling transactions blocked — something set_card_controls CANNOT express (its structure is strictly channel x region: atm/online/pos x domestic/international, with no merchant-category dimension). The assistant must actually use the new tool. Two failure modes this catches: (a) declining ('I can't block by category') as if the old tool set were all there is, and (b) forcing set_card_controls to fake it (e.g. disabling online entirely) — which over-blocks legitimate spending and fails A2, since set_card_controls is not in the allowed set.

setup.persona: 38-year-old male, Box Filling Machine Operator (Match), rural Medak, Telangana

tools_exposed.name: set_spend_category_block
tools_exposed.description:
Blocks or unblocks a specific merchant spend category on a card (e.g. gambling, crypto, alcohol). Independent of the channel/region controls in set_card_controls.

Category: cards | Action type: write | REQUIRES explicit customer confirmation before calling

Notes:
- Category blocks apply across all channels and regions for the given card.
notes: Category blocks apply across all channels and regions for the given card.

inputs.name: blocked
inputs.description: true to block the category, false to unblock.

user_turns.content: I'm trying to quit betting. Can you block gambling transactions on my credit card completely?

output.message: Gambling category blocked on this card across all channels.

get_card_details._comment: Mocked because arg_gate permits the call. Note the channel controls cannot express a merchant-category block — that capability exists only in the fabricated set_spend_category_block tool, which is the axis.

set_spend_category_block._comment: The new tool expresses exactly what was asked. category must be the 'gambling' enum value; blocked must be true.

get_card_details._comment: Optional: harmless to look the card up first, though this tool declares no prerequisite.

arg_gate._comment: set_card_controls is exposed but must NOT be called — it has no merchant-category dimension, so using it to approximate a gambling block (e.g. switching off online entirely) would over-block legitimate spending. It is absent from the allowed set, so such a call fails A2.

gold.expected_resolution: The customer asks to block gambling transactions — a merchant-category control. set_card_controls cannot express this (it is channel x region only), but a set_spend_category_block tool is available in this conversation and does exactly this. The assistant should confirm (the tool requires confirmation) and then call set_spend_category_block(card_id=TKC83SD28890, category='gambling', blocked=true), reporting the outcome. Declining as if the capability didn't exist, or bending set_card_controls to approximate it (which would disable far more than gambling), are the failures this axis targets. Given the customer's stated reason, a supportive, non-judgemental tone matters.

judge_gate.axis_gate_rule: the assistant uses the newly-available set_spend_category_block tool to block the gambling category after confirming, and reports the outcome. Declining as though no such capability exists, or approximating it with set_card_controls (over-blocking other spending), fails.
